Select the RREF or corresponding parametric solution.

RREF contains one normalized pivot and two zero rows.
Exactly one radio choice is correct.
permitted_variations: Vary coefficients, constants, signs, row multipliers and row order.
Vary numerical alternatives and which candidate is correct.
Preserve the normalization method, response contract and workload.
